summary: Master AR and VR for enterprise training and operations. Learn XR strategy, hardware procurement, and ROI measurement. Enroll for expert-led training.
lede: Extended reality training uses augmented, virtual and mixed reality to connect digital content with physical environments. It is designed for professionals responsible for workforce readiness, operational efficiency and technology adoption who need to plan XR for training and operations. Participants learn to assess headset options, design immersive training experiences and develop augmented reality work instructions or remote-assistance workflows, while considering performance tracking and deployment risks.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals responsible for workforce readiness, operational efficiency, and the adoption of emerging technologies within complex organizational structures.
modules: Extended Reality Ecosystem and Industry Standards
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of corporate training or operational management. No prior coding or 3D development experience is required, as the course focuses on strategy, procurement, and implementation management rather than software engineering. A laptop with administrative rights is recommended for exploring software dashboards.
